job.title: SAP IT Business Systeme Software Developer

tailoring.headline: SAP IT Business Systeme Software Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud & Java Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in agile teams, CI/CD pipelines, production support and techno-functional analysis, translating business requirements into robust, scalable commerce platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP IT Business Systeme Software Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Sapitbusinesssysteme’s focus on tightly integrating SAP Commerce Cloud with SAP S/4HANA. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring and end-to-end commerce integrations.

bullets.label: **SAP Commerce Expertise**
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), covering product, catalog and pricing modules, ensuring platform stability and scalability.

bullets.label: **API & Integration Leadership**
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST web services and engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, enabling seamless data flow between ERP, MDM and the storefront.

bullets.label: **Agile Techno-Functional Delivery**
bullets.text: Working in agile squads, I translated business requirements into user stories and functional specs, performed code reviews, and supported production issues, consistently meeting quality targets.

bullets.label: **CI/CD and Cloud Operations**
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Jenkins and Docker, driving reliable releases and rapid incident resolution.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

tailoring.why_company: Your commitment to delivering high-impact commerce solutions by tightly coupling SAP Commerce Cloud with SAP S/4HANA resonates with my career focus on end-to-end integration. At Rockwell Automation I streamlined product data synchronization across ERP and MDM systems, and at Shell I enhanced headless commerce APIs. Joining Sapitbusinesssysteme would allow me to apply this proven expertise to accelerate your customers’ digital transformation.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Sapitbusinesssysteme accelerate SAP Commerce-S/4HANA integrations, leveraging my proven track record in Java, Spring and enterprise e-commerce platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering integrations for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to bring my Java and API expertise to Sapitbusinesssysteme’s SAP S/4HANA projects. Open to discuss?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your SAP Commerce Cloud extensions, implement robust OCC APIs and set up reliable CI/CD pipelines on CCv2, ensuring smooth integration with SAP S/4HANA. My experience with PIM/ERP data pipelines will immediately improve data consistency across your commerce landscape.
tailoring.insight: I notice your platform emphasizes tight SAP Commerce Cloud and S/4HANA integration; my background building PIM-to-ERP pipelines positions me to streamline that connection and reduce data latency.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP IT Business Systeme Software Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am drawn to Sapitbusinesssysteme’s focus on integrating SAP Commerce Cloud with SAP S/4HANA, where my proven experience in Java, OCC APIs and ERP data pipelines can add immediate value. I can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
